```json
{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Support for renewed efforts to reduce, rather than expand, government responsibilities.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Evaluation that the federal government spends too much of the people's money telling the people what they should do.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Our national platform has repeatedly endorsed term limits for Members of Congress.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"In 1996, a constitutional amendment for term limits failed to secure a two-thirds vote in the House.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Eighty percent of Republicans in the House voted for the constitutional amendment for term limits in 1996.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Eighty percent of Democrats in the House voted against the constitutional amendment for term limits in 1996.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Every Senate Republican voted to allow a vote on term limits.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Democrats killed the vote on term limits in the Senate by a filibuster.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Republicans set term limits for their own committee chairs and leadership positions.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Republicans by law required Congress to live by the same rules it imposes on others.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"To advance a constitutional amendment for consideration by the states, expansion of the current Republican majorities in both chambers is necessary.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
